<thought>We need to apply the retrosynthetic template (ID 20810) to the target molecule to obtain its possible precursors. The target SMILES is provided, and the template ID is known from the previous step. Using the apply_template tool will give us the precursor combinations.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
